# Edge cases

## LaTeX-native subequations

The parent is \eqref{eq:subgroup}; its two lines are \eqref{eq:sub-a} and
\eqref{eq:sub-b}.

$$
\begin{subequations}\label{eq:subgroup}
\begin{align}
  a+b &= c, \label{eq:sub-a}\\
  a-b &= d. \label{eq:sub-b}
\end{align}
\end{subequations}
$$

## LaTeX-native separately numbered aligned lines

The two aligned lines are \eqref{eq:line-one} and \eqref{eq:line-two}.

$$
\begin{align}
  x+1 &= 2, \label{eq:line-one}\\
  y+2 &= 4. \label{eq:line-two}
\end{align}
$$
